crossRefs.note: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son…
Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

people.name: Harumaph
people.line: Father of Jedaiah, a repairer of Jerusalem's wall.

people.name: Hattush
people.line: Son of Hashabneiah, a repairer of Jerusalem's wall.

people.name: Jedaiah
people.line: Repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall

translations.web: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
translations.bsb: next to him, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house; and next to him, Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
translations.kjv: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
translations.asv: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabneiah.
